name: Tourist Entry (Visa-Free / eVisa / Consular Visa)

qualifying_event.description: Morocco exempts nationals of roughly 72 countries (EU states, several non-EU European countries, most of the Americas and Asia-Pacific, and select Middle East/Africa nations) from a visa for tourism. Most exempt nationalities get 90 visa-free days (30 days for Hong Kong/Macao/Maldives, 60 for the Dominican Republic). Non-exempt nationalities need either an eVisa (available to a limited set of nationalities/residents) or a traditional consular visa.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Passport valid for the full stay (national ID cards not accepted); proof of accommodation; proof of sufficient funds; return ticket.

requirements.blocker_text: A passport valid for the entire stay is required; national ID cards are not accepted even for otherwise-exempt nationalities.
Proof of accommodation, sufficient funds, and a return ticket are required even for visa-exempt travelers.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days for most exempt/visa nationalities (30 or 60 days for a small number of exceptions)

sources.title: visapourmaroc.fr -- Morocco visa-exemption list: ~72 exempt countries, 90-day standard stay (30/60-day exceptions), eVisa (7 nationalities, EUR 117, 4 business days) or consular visa for others
